parameters.content:
## Google Maps Business Lead & Email Finder

**Actor:** [Google Maps Business Lead & Email Finder](https://apify.com/dataspryva/google-maps-business-lead-and-email-finder)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/google-maps-business-lead-and-email-finder.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `searchQueries` (array)
- `locationQuery` (string)
- `category` (string)
- `keyword` (string)
- `state` (string)
- `country` (string)
- `websites` (array)
- `placeUrls` (array)
- `placeIds` (array)
- `max_results` (integer)
- `minRating` (number)

### Output fields
- `name` (Business)
- `googleBusinessCategories` (Categories)
- `street` (Street)
- `city` (City)
- `state` (State / region)
- `zip` (Postal code)
- `country` (Country)
- `countryCode` (Country code)
- `phoneNumber` (Phone)
- `url` (Website)
- `email` (Email)
- `emails` (Emails)

description: Google Maps leads with emails: runs the Google Maps Business Lead & Email Finder Apify Actor, returns name, googleBusinessCategories, phoneNumber, email, reviewScore and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
